theater: 黎巴嫩南部與貝卡谷地

battle.name: 第五次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 黎巴嫩南部與貝卡谷地
battle.brief: 一九八二年六月六日，以色列以「和平為加利利」為名越過利塔尼河，三路大軍直取貝魯特與貝卡谷地，九日一次大規模空襲摧毀敘利亞地空導彈網。卡面這輛一九七九年入列的梅卡瓦主戰坦克是突破與防衛的骨幹：一百二十公厘滑膛砲在谷地坦克戰中壓過敘軍的一百一十五公厘砲，七日之內把戰線推到貝魯特城郊。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦主戰坦克是以色列陸軍當時的核心裝甲載具，負責正面突破與裝甲防衛，並可和步兵、裝甲車及炮兵協同，構成地面部隊的主要坦克火力。

countries: 以軍一方由貝京內閣主導，國防部長佩雷斯與沙龍負責政治層面，參謀總長拉賓中將統一指揮全國作戰，黎巴嫩方向由北部司令部具體負責。前線投入四個師級單位：第162師負責南線沿地中海岸向泰爾推進，第252師在中央突破，第769預備役師接替擴展戰果，第8裝甲師進入貝卡谷地攻擊敘軍防空陣地；師以下有傘兵旅、突擊大隊、裝甲旅與工兵部隊，另有炮兵部隊與空軍、海軍的火力支援。停火前以軍在黎境內的指揮層級為師、旅、營三級，後勤由國防軍後勤司令部統一調度。以色列在山區還拉攏了德魯茲派武裝：進步社會黨領袖朱姆布拉特率部眾在貝卡以南的山區與以軍並肩作戰，擊退法蘭西黨民兵。對方是巴解組織及其在黎巴嫩的武裝、黎巴嫩左翼陣線與部分民兵。巴解的作戰指揮權在阿布·賈希德手中，據點遍佈貝魯特西部城區與南黎的營地；黎巴嫩武裝部隊在薩伊德·哈達德率領下於六月三日整建制倒戈加入巴解，使以軍在南部首先遇到的抵抗由原建制黎軍與民兵組成。法蘭西黨的民兵與以軍在南部部分地區合作，其領導人為巴希爾·傑馬伊爾。敘利亞是第三方主要參與者：阿薩德政府以共禦為名投入兵員與空軍，在貝卡谷地佈置地空導彈群、裝甲師與炮兵，指揮由大馬士革的總參謀部掌握，先期投入第10裝甲師，導彈防線崩潰後再增派第3裝甲師。美國不參戰，但以情報共享、空中後勤與外交庇護協助以軍，國務卿海格明言不會否決以方行動，這一立場被外界稱為溫伯格主義。聯合國安理會就此事屢次開會，因否決權行使，最終並未形成任何有效制裁。
countriesEn: The Israeli side was driven by the Begin cabinet, with Defence Minister Peres and Ariel Sharon responsible at the political level and Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Yitzhak Rabin exercising overall command, the Lebanon front being run in detail by the Northern Command. Four division-scale formations were committed to the front: the 162nd Division on the southern axis pushing north along the Mediterranean coast towards Tyre, the 252nd Division in the central penetration, the 769th Reserve Division to extend the gains, and the 8th Armored Division in the Bekaa Valley to attack the Syrian air defences; below them were parachute brigades, commando formations, armoured brigades and engineer units, with artillery and air force and naval fire support. The Israeli command in Lebanon ran at divisional, brigadier and battalion level, with logistics handled centrally by the IDF logistics command. In the mountains Israel also enlisted the Druze: the Progressive Socialist Party under Walid Jumblatt fought alongside Israeli forces in the hills south of the Bekaa and turned back Phalange militia. The other side was the Palestine Liberation Organization and its armed groups in Lebanon, the Lebanese Leftist Front and a number of militias. Operational command of the PLO rested with Abu Jihad, and its positions ran through West Beirut and the camps of southern Lebanon; the Lebanese Armed Forces under Said Haddad went over in one body to the PLO on 3 June, so that the first resistance met by Israeli troops in the south was made up of former regular Lebanese soldiers and militia. Phalange militias cooperated with the Israelis in parts of the south under their leader Bashir Gemayel. Syria was the principal third participant: President Hafez al-Assad invoked a common defence and committed troops and an air force, laying out a surface-to-air missile group, armoured divisions and artillery in the Bekaa Valley under the General Staff in Damascus, the 10th Armoured Division going in first and the 3rd Armoured Division sent forward after the missile line had collapsed. The United States did not fight but assisted with intelligence, aerial logistic support and diplomatic cover, and Secretary of State Alexander Haig said openly that Washington would not veto Israeli action, a position described abroad as the Weinberger Doctrine. The United Nations Security Council met repeatedly on the matter; with the veto in play no effective measure was ever adopted.
people: 關鍵人物集中在三地。以色列方面，總理貝京力排眾議堅持出兵，並在內閣中以安全的說法統一立場；國防部長佩雷斯主張打有限的一場戰，沙龍則力主擴大戰果、深入貝卡谷地，這個分歧實際上決定了戰役的規模；參謀總長拉賓中將在戰前一年剛主導過黎巴嫩南部的行動，熟悉地形與對手的部署，他主張在總參謀部層面統籌對敘作戰，以軍能攻入貝卡谷地的前提，正是他力主先摧毀敘軍防空網。南部戰線的第162師師長貝尼-加爾少將率部沿海岸北進，在泰爾與哈爾巴方向頂住巴解與民兵的重壓，是全役地面戰最吃力的指揮官之一。被暗殺未遂的以色列駐黎大使施洛莫·阿戈夫在六月三日於貝魯特遇襲，肩部與脊椎重傷，此事成為開戰的直接導火線。以色列情報機構認定巴解內部知情並提供便利，但此說法在美國國內引發所謂布倫納事件的爭議——以色列駐美武官阿莫斯·比蘭向媒體表示以方掌握巴解涉案證據，事後被指為事後追認，開戰理由在華盛頓因此備受質疑。敘利亞方面，總統阿薩德在六月初召開最高軍政會議決定派遣裝甲師南下，但以方情報認為敘方最初僅作象徵性部署，直到谷地防空網被摧毀才投入主力。巴解方面，主席阿拉法特在大馬士革與突尼斯之間往返協調，戰時的軍事指揮依靠阿布·賈希德。黎巴嫩方面，德魯茲領袖朱姆布拉特在九月初與以方達成默契，以軍讓出其控制的山區，換取德魯茲武裝對付巴解；法蘭西黨領袖傑馬伊爾在戰後數月被暗殺，使以黎之間的軍事合作失去政治載體。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were concentrated in three places. On the Israeli side, Prime Minister Begin overrode all objection and insisted on going to war, holding the cabinet together with the language of security; Defence Minister Peres argued for a limited war while Sharon pressed for wider results and a drive into the Bekaa, and that disagreement effectively set the scale of the campaign; Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Yitzhak Rabin, who had run the operations in southern Lebanon only a year earlier and knew the ground and the opposing dispositions intimately, argued for running the war against Syria at General Staff level, and the condition for the Israeli drive into the Bekaa was precisely his insistence on destroying the Syrian missile shield first. In the south, Major General Avigdor Ben-Gal, commander of the 162nd Division, drove north along the coast and absorbed heavy pressure from the PLO and the militias around Tyre and Harba, and was one of the most hard-pressed commanders of the ground war. The attempt on the life of the Israeli ambassador to Lebanon, Shlomo Argov, on 3 June in Beirut left him with severe shoulder and spinal injuries and became the immediate trigger for the war. Israeli intelligence held that elements inside the PLO knew of and facilitated the attempt, but the claim generated the so-called Brenner affair in the United States: Amos Biran, the Israeli military attaché, told the media that Israel held evidence of PLO involvement, afterwards described as a retroactive justification, and the stated reason for the war was therefore heavily questioned in Washington. On the Syrian side, President Hafez al-Assad convened the highest military and political council in early June to commit an armoured division, though Israeli intelligence judged that Syria's initial deployment was token only and that the main effort went in after the missile shield had been destroyed. On the PLO side, Chairman Yasser Arafat shuttled between Damascus and Tunis to coordinate, and day-to-day military command rested with Abu Jihad. On the Lebanese side, the Druze leader Walid Jumblatt reached an understanding with the Israelis in early September, the army giving way in the mountains he controlled in exchange for Druze help against the PLO; and the Phalange leader Bashir Gemayel was assassinated in the months after the war, which removed the political carrier from the Israeli-Lebanese military cooperation.
kits: 本卡兵器是梅卡瓦主戰坦克，一九七九年初入列以色列陸軍，是當時以軍唯一國產主力坦克。梅卡瓦一型的技術特徵非常明確：戰鬥全重約五十二點六噸，乘員四人，車體最前部是前置的 MTU MB838 柴油發動機，發動機、傳動與燃油箱佔據車體前半，戰鬥室位於中部，彈藥架與步兵乘員艙在車尾；這種前置發動機、後置彈藥的佈局把最危險的部位夾在車體中段，並留出車尾載人的空間，犧牲的則是車體前段的迎彈面積與整體防禦佈局。武器是一門德國 Rh-120 一百二十公厘滑膛砲，採用分離裝藥與高爆被甲外形彈，炮口初速約九百米每秒，公開資料中的穿甲威力約為兩千米距離上五百五十毫米鋼板，明顯優於以軍同期仍在使用的 Centurion 與 Magach 7 上的一百零五公厘線膛砲。梅卡瓦一型配四檔手排，公路最大速度約每小時六十公里，行程約四百五十公里，初期型號的發動機可靠性與散熱仍有問題。其餘裝甲序列裡有英製 Centurion 的以色列改裝型 M50 與 M60、美國授權生產的 Magach 7、還有 M48 半裝甲車與大量裝甲運兵車。對面的蘇制裝備有 T-54 與 T-55、T-62（一百一十五公厘滑膛砲）以及一九七九年才成軍的 T-72（一百二十五公厘滑膛砲），其中 T-62 與 T-72 在火力和火控上並不弱於梅卡瓦一型，火控與測距系統的差距才是關鍵。空中與遠程火力方面，以軍有 F-15A、F-4E、A-4 與新服役的 Kfir，敘軍有 MiG-21、MiG-23、MiG-25 與 Su-17。地面防空由敘軍的 SA-2、SA-3 與 SA-6 三層地空導彈構成，另有 ZSU-23-4 自行高射砲。炮兵方面以軍有一百三十公厘與一百五十五公厘自走砲，後方補給靠 C-130 運輸機與 CH-53 重型直昇機維持。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Merkava Mark 1 main battle tank, which entered Israeli Army service in the early months of 1979 and was the country's only domestically produced main battle tank. The technical characteristics of the Mark 1 are quite precise: combat weight of about 52.6 tonnes, a crew of four, a front-mounted MTU MB838 diesel engine, transmission and fuel occupying the forward half of the hull, the fighting compartment in the middle, and the ammunition rack and infantry compartment at the rear. This arrangement of engine in front and ammunition behind puts the most vulnerable elements in the middle of the hull and leaves a troop-carrying space at the back; what it sacrifices is the frontal area and the overall layout of protection. The armament is a German Rh-120 120mm smoothbore gun firing separate-charge ammunition and HEAT-FS shells, with a muzzle velocity of about 900 metres per second and a published penetration figure of roughly 550 millimetres of rolled homogeneous steel at two thousand metres, clearly ahead of the 105mm rifled guns of the Centurion and Magach 7 still in Israeli service. The Mark 1 has a four-speed manual transmission, a road speed of about 60 kilometres per hour and a range of roughly 450 kilometres, and early vehicles still had problems with engine reliability and cooling. The rest of the armoured order of battle included Israeli-upgraded Centurions in the M50 and M60 versions, the American-licensed Magach 7, the M48, and large numbers of half-tracks and armoured personnel carriers. On the opposing side the Soviet equipment was the T-54 and T-55, the T-62 with its 115mm smoothbore gun, and the T-72 with a 125mm smoothbore, a type that only reached operational status in 1979; the T-62 and T-72 were in no way inferior to the Merkava Mark 1 in firepower, and it was the gap in fire control and rangefinding that mattered. On the air and long-range side, Israel fielded the F-15A, F-4E, A-4 and the newly entered service Kfir, while Syria had the MiG-21, MiG-23, MiG-25 and Su-17. Ground air defence was built on the three-layer Syrian system of SA-2, SA-3 and SA-6 surface-to-air missiles, with ZSU-23-4 self-propelled anti-aircraft guns. On the artillery side Israel had 130mm and 155mm self-propelled guns, and rear-area supply was sustained by C-130 transports and CH-53 heavy-lift helicopters.
tactics: 以軍的戰術是一條按時間鋪開的鏈條，而梅卡瓦在其中承擔的是矛頭與鉗的角色。第一階段是空地一體的突破。六月六日拂曉前，飛機先對南黎的巴解據點與谷地的敘軍陣地實施密集攻擊，四個師級單位自三個方向同時越過利塔尼河，渡河點包括納庫拉與阿里兩處，以及利塔尼公路橋所在的河段；以軍甚至出動飛機在橋頭阻止敘軍工兵炸橋，把這條沿海公路留給自己的裝甲縱隊。渡河後各部不在公路上正面推擠，而是在黎南縱深展開成大縱深梯隊，由傘兵與突擊大隊乘突擊艇與直昇機在敵後著陸，切斷巴解的交通與撤退路線，裝甲部隊沿兩翼與中央快速推進，配合以空軍支援的縱深打擊。第二階段是貝卡谷地的空戰與坦克戰。六月九日以軍出動約二百架次飛機對谷地實施一次罕見的大規模攻擊，先摧毀地空導彈的指揮與雷達，再摧毀 SA-2 發射陣地，其後每日襲擊清除 SA-3，SA-6 發射車最終由第8裝甲師的坦克火力與武裝直昇機的導彈在地面摧毀。失去防空傘的敘軍裝甲部隊在谷地內被分割包圍，雙方在縱深數十公里內反覆交鋒，梅卡瓦一型以長身管與較高初速的砲在遠距離射擊中取得優勢，敘軍的 T-62 則依靠火控與數量在近距離反擊。六月十日前後的阿拉莫行動中，以軍突擊大隊塗黑面部操縱繳獲的敘軍 T-55 坦克向敵陣接近，以免被雷達辨識，是這場戰爭中最特殊的一次戰術試驗。第三階段是封鎖與圍城：以軍推進到貝魯特與的黎波里周邊後停住，改以海軍巡邏艇、護衛艦與登陸艇切斷沿海公路與海運，在貝魯特外圍建立封鎖線，自六月中旬起的兩個多月裡燃料與糧食耗盡，八月十日巴解武裝撤出。第四階段延伸到山區：九月以軍與德魯茲派聯合，在貝卡以南把巴解的據點逐一拔除，梅卡瓦三型以一百二十公厘砲對上敘軍 T-62 與巴解的 T-55。
tacticsEn: The Israeli method was a chain laid out in time, and the Merkava carried the roles of spearhead and pincer in it. The first phase was a combined air and ground breakthrough. Before dawn on 6 June, aircraft struck the PLO positions in southern Lebanon and the Syrian positions in the valley in dense raids, and four division-scale formations crossed the Litani River simultaneously from three directions, the crossing points including Naqoura and A'ali and the stretch of river at the Litani road bridge; the Israeli air force even went in to stop Syrian engineers from blowing the bridge, keeping the coastal road for its own armoured columns. Rather than pushing head-on along the road, the formations fanned out into large columns in depth across southern Lebanon, paratroopers and commandos going ashore behind the enemy lines by landing craft and helicopter to cut the PLO's communications and lines of retreat, while armoured units advanced quickly along the flanks and the centre, working with air-delivered strikes in depth. The second phase was the air war and the tank war in the Bekaa. On 9 June the Israeli air force put about two hundred aircraft sorties over the valley in one of the largest attacks of its history, destroying first the command posts and radars of the missile system and then the SA-2 launch sites, clearing the SA-3 in the daily raids that followed, while the SA-6 launch vehicles were finally destroyed on the ground by the guns of the 8th Armored Division and by missiles from armed helicopters. Syrian armoured formations stripped of their air cover were cut up and surrounded in the valley, and the two sides fought it out repeatedly at depths of tens of kilometres; the Merkava Mark 1 gained the advantage at long range with its long barrel and higher muzzle velocity, while the Syrian T-62 fought back at short range on the strength of its fire control and its numbers. In the Alamo operation around 10 June, an Israeli commando team painted their faces black and manned captured Syrian T-55 tanks in an approach on the enemy position so as not to be identified by radar, the most unusual tactical experiment of the whole war. The third phase was blockade and siege: after the advance reached the outskirts of Beirut and Sidon, the Israelis halted and cut the coastal road and the sea lanes with naval patrol boats, frigates and landing craft, running a blockade line around Beirut; over the more than two months from mid-June the fuel and food ran out, and on 10 August the PLO fighters withdrew. The fourth phase extended into the mountains: in September Israeli and Druze forces worked together to clear the PLO's positions south of the Bekaa, the Merkava Mark 3 meeting Syrian T-62s and PLO T-55s with its 120mm gun.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。全役主戰階段自一九八二年六月六日至六月十二日，前後七天，其後是長達兩個月的圍城與零星戰鬥。六月六日拂曉以軍即越過利塔尼河，兩天內前推到貝魯特外圍，戰役全程自利塔尼河到貝卡谷地縱深約一百公里，谷地本身長約一百公里、寬不足十五公里。以軍投入的地面部隊在數萬至十萬之間，計有四個師級單位及數個旅團級部隊；巴解在黎巴嫩的武裝人員一般估計約二萬人。傷亡方面，以色列軍方陣亡約三百七十至四百人；敘利亞軍方陣亡的估計在二千人以上，較常被引用的是二千五百至三千之間，其中絕大多數在貝卡谷地；巴解與黎巴嫩民兵一方陣亡人數的各項統計差異極大，多在千餘至兩千人的量級；黎巴嫩政府軍亦有數百人陣亡。裝甲損失同樣有爭議，以軍損失坦克的數字常被引用為約一百二十輛，敘軍在谷地損失的坦克多估為四百至五百輛，另有數百輛裝甲運兵車與步兵戰車被毀。空中方面，六月九日摧毀谷地防空網的一役，以軍出動飛機約二百架次，是當時以軍史上最大規模的一次單日攻勢，敘軍在谷地的地空導彈發射陣地基本全數失效。梅卡瓦一型的公開諸元為：戰鬥全重約五十二點六噸，乘員四人，裝有一百二十公厘滑膛砲一門，公路最大速度約每小時六十公里，最大行程約四百五十公里，發動機功率約八百一十馬力。圍城階段自六月中旬至八月十日約五十餘日，最後撤出貝魯特的巴解武裝連同裝備共約二千人，分由海路運往突尼斯。各家數字互相出入之處不少，上列取主流估計。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are broadly as follows. The main phase of the campaign ran from 6 June to 12 June 1982, seven days in all, and was followed by a siege of more than two months and scattered fighting. The Israelis crossed the Litani before dawn on 6 June and were at the outskirts of Beirut within two days; the operation ran about a hundred kilometres in depth from the Litani to the Bekaa, and the valley itself is about a hundred kilometres long and less than fifteen wide. The Israeli ground commitment lay somewhere between tens of thousands and a hundred thousand men, in four division-scale formations and a number of brigades and regiments; the PLO's armed personnel in Lebanon are generally put at about twenty thousand. On casualties, Israeli military dead are put at about 370 to 400; Syrian military dead are estimated at more than 2,000, with 2,500 to 3,000 the most frequently cited figure, the overwhelming majority of them in the Bekaa; the counts for the PLO and the Lebanese militias vary enormously between accounts and lie in the range of a thousand to two thousand; several hundred members of the Lebanese government forces were also killed. Armour losses are equally disputed: the number of Israeli tanks lost is commonly given as about 120, Syrian tank losses in the valley are mostly estimated at 400 to 500, and several hundred armoured personnel carriers and infantry fighting vehicles were destroyed. In the air, the 9 June operation that destroyed the valley air defence network put about two hundred aircraft into the sky in a single day, the largest single-day offensive in Israeli history at the time, and effectively all the surface-to-air missile sites in the valley were neutralised. The published figures for the Merkava Mark 1 are: combat weight about 52.6 tonnes, crew of four, one 120mm smoothbore gun, road speed about 60 kilometres per hour, maximum range about 450 kilometres, engine power of about 810 horsepower. The siege lasted something over fifty days from mid-June to 10 August, and the PLO fighters finally withdrawn from Beirut numbered about two thousand with their equipment, taken out by sea to Tunis. The figures differ in many places between sources, and the above follow the mainstream estimates.
cause: 開火有近因與遠因兩層。近因是六月三日的暗殺未遂：以色列駐黎巴嫩大使施洛莫·阿戈夫在貝魯特出席紀念儀式時，車上被安裝遙控炸藥，肩部與脊椎重傷，兇手是一個與巴解分裂的阿布·尼達爾一系武裝。巴解否認參與，但以色列情報機構認定巴解內部知情並提供便利，此說法在美方引起所謂布倫納事件——以色列駐美武官阿莫斯·比蘭向記者表示以方掌握巴解涉案證據，事後被指為事後追認，也讓開戰理由在美國國內備受質疑。遠因是黎巴嫩局勢的結構性惡化。一九八〇年代，巴解以貝魯特為據點，武裝人數與影響力急升；以色列支持的法蘭西黨與黎巴嫩政府軍在南部與山區對巴解發動戰役，一九八一年十月以色列空襲貝魯特巴解總部，一九八二年三月法蘭西黨在宰赫勒一帶的攻殺又激化了對抗。以色列自一九八一年起在利塔尼河一線劃出以軍的撤退線作為緩衝，但巴解武裝仍不斷越界滲入加利利地區，以色列指其策劃在境內製造恐怖行動。國際層面上，美國國務卿海格在六月四日前後表示不否決以色列依一九四九年停戰協定第十一條採取行動，國防部長溫伯格則宣稱以色列不是美國的當事人、美國不予勸阻。以色列在國內經過兩天準備後，於六月六日清晨開火。
causeEn: The firing had a proximate cause and a deeper one. The proximate cause was the attempted assassination of 3 June: the Israeli ambassador to Lebanon, Shlomo Argov, was attending a commemorative ceremony in Beirut when a remote-controlled explosive device was placed on his car, giving him severe shoulder and spinal wounds; the attackers belonged to an Abu Nidal splinter organisation opposed to the PLO. The PLO denied involvement, but Israeli intelligence held that elements inside the organisation knew of and facilitated the attempt, a claim that produced the so-called Brenner affair in the United States, in which Amos Biran, the Israeli military attaché, told a journalist that Israel held evidence of PLO responsibility, afterwards described as a retroactive justification, and which left the stated reason for the war heavily questioned in Washington. The deeper cause was the structural deterioration of the Lebanese situation. Through the 1980s the PLO used Beirut as its base and its armed strength and political influence grew fast; the Phalange, backed by Israel, and the Lebanese government forces fought the PLO in the south and in the mountains, Israel bombed the PLO headquarters in Beirut in October 1981, and the killings carried out by the Phalange around Zahle in March 1982 sharpened the confrontation. From 1981 Israel had drawn a line of withdrawal along the Litani as a buffer, but PLO armed groups kept crossing into the Galilee and Israel accused them of planning terrorist operations inside its own territory. At the international level, United States Secretary of State Haig said around 4 June that Washington would not veto Israeli action under Article 11 of the 1949 Armistice Agreement, and Defence Secretary Weinberger declared that Israel was not a party to the conflict and would not be restrained by the United States. After two days of preparation at home, Israel fired at dawn on 6 June.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果在軍事與政治上都留下長久後果。就巴解組織而言，它在黎巴嫩作為有建制的軍隊存在了八年之後被逐出黎巴嫩，成建制的武裝在西奈、約旦與突尼斯一帶流散，後來在突尼斯重建，這是巴解在政治上的重大挫折，但同時也改變了它的鬥爭形式：游擊式的武裝鬥爭重新佔據上風。以軍則經過這場戰爭的檢驗後全面升級，坦克戰、空中作戰與精確導引武器的運用成為以色列軍事文化的核心部分。黎巴嫩方面的變化最為深遠：以軍的長期佔領帶來一個此前不存在的抵抗力量，真主黨於一九八二年成立，以抵抗佔領為旗號在黎巴嫩南部扎根，日後成為以色列在黎巴嫩的主要對手，直到二〇〇〇年以軍撤出。戰爭也撕毀了以軍與德魯茲派的合作基礎——一九八二年九月的山區戰役中以軍協助德魯茲派對付巴解與法蘭西黨，法蘭西黨民兵隨即在貝魯特南郊的沙布拉與沙提拉犯下大殺戮，激怒了原先的盟友，黎巴嫩全國和解的設想因此破產。在國際層面，美國因以色列入侵而在一九八二年對以實施武器禁運，一九八三年才解除，歐共體以宣言形式譴責以色列的行動，聯合國安理會第516與第519號決議譴責侵略並要求撤退，卻因美方否決而無從執行。這場戰爭也讓人看到，以色列與阿拉伯國家的對抗並未因埃及和約而中斷，冷戰後期中東的和解曲線在這裡出現折斷。
impactEn: The consequences of the war were lasting on both the military and the political side. For the Palestine Liberation Organization, eight years of existing in Lebanon as a constituted army ended with its expulsion from the country; the formed units dispersed into Sinai, Jordan and Tunis and were later rebuilt in Tunis, which was a serious political blow, yet it also changed the form of the struggle, with guerrilla warfare regaining the upper hand. Israel, by contrast, came out of the campaign upgraded, with armoured warfare, air operations and precision-guided weapons moving to the core of Israeli military culture. The deepest change was in Lebanon: the long Israeli occupation produced a resistance force that had not existed before, Hezbollah being founded in 1982 to fight the occupation, taking root in southern Lebanon and becoming Israel's main adversary there until the withdrawal in 2000. The war also destroyed the military cooperation between Israel and the Druze: in the mountain campaign of September 1982 the Israelis helped the Druze against the PLO and the Phalange, and Phalange militia then carried out a large massacre at Sabra and Shatila on the southern outskirts of Beirut, alienating the former allies and wrecking the idea of a national reconciliation in Lebanon. At the international level the United States imposed an arms embargo on Israel in 1982 over the invasion and did not lift it until 1983, the European Community condemned Israeli action in the form of a declaration, and Security Council resolutions 516 and 519 deplored the aggression and demanded a withdrawal but were made ineffective by the American veto. The war also made it plain that confrontation between Israel and the Arab states had not been interrupted by the Egyptian peace treaty, and the curve of reconciliation in the Middle East broke here in the late Cold War.
result: 作戰結果集中在六月的九天。六月六日越過利塔尼河之後，以軍在三天內把戰線推到貝魯特城郊，摧毀南黎大部分巴解陣地與谷地的敘軍防空網；六月八日完成對貝魯特西區的包圍，六月九日至十一日在貝卡谷地展開坦克與步兵的對攻，第8裝甲師的部隊在谷地內消滅了敘軍裝甲主力與殘存的 SA-6 發射車，敘利亞第10裝甲師被擊潰，第3裝甲師尚未投入即退回境內。以軍沒有攻入貝魯特西區市中心的巴解據點，而是選擇圍而不攻：六月中旬起封鎖線切斷城內海運與陸路供應，燃料與糧食迅速見底；南部的泰爾與的黎波里方向的巴解陣地相繼在七月被攻破或投降。八月十日，約二千名巴解武裝人員連同裝備自海路撤往突尼斯，圍城結束，以軍進駐貝魯特西部。但作戰勝利並未轉化為政治勝利。佔領帶來游擊戰，新的抵抗組織在黎南部成立；法蘭西黨與以軍的同盟在山區戰役中破裂，德魯茲派轉而驅逐以軍；一九八三年以軍自貝卡谷地山區撤出，一九八四年黎巴嫩政府軍在貝卡谷地南部與以軍對峙，一九八五年達成協議把貝魯特與部分山區防務交予政府軍。一九九〇年海灣戰爭之後，以軍才於二〇〇〇年五月完成全面撤出。對以色列而言，這是一場付出高昂代價卻未帶來持久安全的戰爭；對巴解而言，它喪失了一支軍隊，也換來更長的游擊戰傳統；對黎巴嫩而言，戰爭留下的不只是內戰，還有主權與佔領的問題。
resultEn: The operational results came within nine days in June. Having crossed the Litani on 6 June, the Israeli army drove the front to the outskirts of Beirut within three days, destroying most PLO positions in southern Lebanon and the Syrian missile shield in the valley; the encirclement of West Beirut was complete on 8 June, and between 9 and 11 June the armoured and infantry war of the Bekaa reached its height, the 8th Armored Division destroying the main body of the Syrian armour and the surviving SA-6 launch vehicles in the valley, the Syrian 10th Armoured Division being routed and the 3rd Armoured Division withdrawing to its own borders before it was committed. The Israelis did not storm the PLO positions in the centre of West Beirut but chose to surround rather than assault: from mid-June the blockade line cut the sea and land supply to the city, fuel and food ran short quickly, and the PLO positions at Tyre and in the Sidon direction in the south were stormed or capitulated in July. On 10 August some two thousand PLO fighters with their equipment were taken out by sea to Tunis, the siege ended, and the Israeli army took up positions in West Beirut. But operational success did not turn into political success. The occupation brought guerrilla war, and a new resistance organisation took root in southern Lebanon; the alliance between the Phalange and Israel broke up in the mountain campaign, the Druze turning instead to drive the Israelis out; Israel withdrew from the Bekaa mountains in 1983, the Lebanese government forces confronted the Israelis in the southern Bekaa in 1984, and an agreement in 1985 handed the defence of Beirut and part of the mountains to the government forces. Only after the Gulf War of 1990 did Israel complete its withdrawal in May 2000. For Israel this was a war fought at high cost that brought no lasting security; for the PLO it cost the organisation an army but bought it a longer tradition of guerrilla war; and for Lebanon the war left something more than a civil war, namely the unresolved questions of sovereignty and occupation.
